scope: terminal policy portability, not multi-turn downstream-effect replication
sampling: same historical 300 common qids, reused descriptive sample
legacy_tag: FACT is the implementation alias for ADMITTED; STATUS is never reused
comparison: All three arms share freshly generated initial answer and, on strict failure, one freshly generated RepairRead; only failed-repair output/storage actions differ. Fail-open and ADMIT have identical terminal output/calls by construction.
note: Graph-based upstreams (HopRAG, MoLoRAG local reproductions); same qids, contract, reader, decoding, and serialization as the other sixteen.

upstream_construction.hoprag: Released HopRAG graph construction and bfs_node traversal (prompts from config.py), Qwen3-8B with thinking off, temperature 0.1; nodes = OCR/text chunks (bge-base-en-v1.5); per-question graph over the documents of the dense top-10 entry nodes (1,162 documents, 31,447 nodes with questions, 695,143 edges); topk 10, four hops; graph held in memory instead of Neo4j.
upstream_construction.molorag: Released MoLoRAG beam search (beam 3, max_hop 4, alpha 0.4, threshold 0.3) with the training-free Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct page judge (detailed relevance prompt, 16 tokens); ColPali v1.3 page scores; candidate documents of the ColPali top-20 pages, page graphs k=5, cosine >= 0.8 of mean-pooled page embeddings; selected pages read through PyMuPDF OCR/text (4,000 characters).
